summary: The prepared base already contains upstream PR #36911's issue-specific DFlash post-capture verify rehearsal and measured sampling-headroom reservation, plus PR #38596's independent KV-canary workspace reservation. No production source correction was needed.

tests.what_was_measured: Current-source startup ordering, DFlash verify buffer lifetime, post-capture sampling/canary headroom accounting, target/draft maximum-workspace boundary, and canary-disabled byte-budget boundary; 26 tests and 27 subtests passed.

tests.command: Focused Python regression equivalent to TestGraphPoolBorrow.test_dflash_prewarm_falls_back_when_the_rehearsal_exhausts_the_pool with only pool.is_cuda and DFlash kernel availability mocked true
tests.what_was_measured: Issue-specific fallback sequence [warm outside borrow, borrowed rehearsal OOM, retry outside borrow] = [false, true, false], and persistence of 2048 bytes measured headroom for a 1024-byte synthetic sampling input. Tensor allocations executed on the assigned gfx950 GPU.

tests.command: Unmodified focused pytest invocation including TestGraphPoolBorrow.test_dflash_prewarm_falls_back_when_the_rehearsal_exhausts_the_pool; JUnit: reports/j-804826e4c28c/evidence/focused_current.xml
tests.what_was_measured: 13 tests passed; the CUDA-only borrow regression was incorrectly selected on ROCm because torch.cuda.is_available() is true under HIP, then failed because production graph_pool_borrow_enabled() correctly returns false on non-CUDA. This is retained as a platform/test limitation, not issue reproduction.

tests.command: Real-gfx950 DFlash HIP top-p normalization compared with an independent CPU float64 sort/cumulative-sum/scatter reference; exact tensor-byte scaling checked for draft counts 1, 8, and 16
tests.what_was_measured: Maximum absolute numerical difference 8.738910914352083e-10; maximum probability-row sum error 1.1920928955078125e-07; probability input bytes 1048576, 8388608, and 16777216, confirming linear draft-token scaling.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, ROCm torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. GPU tensors were used in the fallback fixture and numerical reference. The CUDA-only DFlash sampling-verify kernel reported unavailable.
remaining_limitations: The original 2x8 A800 TP8 mooncake-RDMA PD deployment and 122B target/6-layer draft weights were unavailable.
The CUDA/SM80 DFlash sampling-verify kernel and original HTTP 500 mid-traffic failure could not be executed on the assigned ROCm gfx950 GPU.
No full-model, multi-GPU, or multi-node reproduction was performed or claimed.

The upstream CUDA-only fallback test is mis-gated on ROCm by torch.cuda.is_available(); the intended logic was validated with the platform predicate mocked, without changing unrelated production code.
